name: HCP Terraform
summary: HCP Terraform is HashiCorp's hosted service for running Terraform. Its pricing page lists Essentials, Standard and Premium at $0.10, $0.47 and $0.99 per resource a month, with a $500 HCP trial credit. Self-managed IBM Terraform Enterprise is quote-only.

facts.text: By default, run plans require confirmation before HCP Terraform applies them, and the View Plan button shows what a run will change.
HCP Terraform runs a speculative plan when a pull request is opened against the branch.
The Terraform docs say state is needed to map configuration to real resources, and that remote locking stops two users running Terraform at the same time.
Standard and Premium include HCP Waypoint, according to the pricing page. Each plan offers the same $500 HCP trial credit.
